title: Writing a case someone else can run without asking a single question

videos.script: A test case is finished when somebody else can run it. {{stranger}} Not you, who wrote it and knows what you meant. Somebody who has never seen the application, with the case and nothing else. {{alone}} Give them a case that says book some tickets and check the price, and the questions start. Which account? Which show? How many is some? {{questions}} And the worst one. What price is correct? A stranger who cannot work that out checks nothing, and the case passes anyway. {{price}} In this lesson you find where the questions come from. Vague words, missing data, and a state nobody wrote down. {{holes}} Then you rewrite one case until a stranger could run it cold, and you run it. {{rewrite}} No quiz can tell you whether you managed it. So the lesson ends with a way to find out. Hand your case to a person, and stay quiet. {{hand}}
